text:
Nora Kim: :loudspeaker: Announcing: Regional data-residency mirrors for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments. This adds an official pattern for customers who need local data locality (read replicas & compliance-friendly mirrors) without moving production control planes. Summary + rollout plan below.

Felipe Alvarez: Quick question: is this full failover or read-only replication?

Nora Kim: Two modes: 1) local-read replica (read-only, for queries and audit tooling), 2) sync-enabled mirror (eventual-consistent, used for local analytics and disaster recovery). Full failover is not automatic in v1; will be manual with SRE assistance.

Imogen Shaw: Compliance POV: this helps customers in APAC/EU who must keep embeddings/logs locally for GDPR/PDPA. What data categories are mirrored?

Nora Kim: Mirrors include: embeddings, audit logs, index shards (configurable), and anonymized telemetry if customer opts in. Secrets/keys never leave the primary HSM boundary unless customer explicitly configures a mirrored KMS wrapper. See appendix in docs.

Priya Rao: Important: mirrors are opt-in for existing clusters. New installs in targeted regions will default to a mirror-capable install with mirror disabled. Well provide a simple opt-in flow in Console and an installer flag for on-prem.

Jordan Lee: Customer communication: we need a short advisory + FAQ. Include guidance on latency tradeoffs and cost delta for storage. Ill draft.

Nora Kim: Rollout plan: week 1: private preview for selected enterprise customers; week 3: canary cohort (3 customers); week 6: GA for all new installs in supported regions; week 10: opt-in window closes for older installs (customers can still opt-in via support).

Felipe Alvarez: Ops notes: syncing uses an encrypted gRPC channel with per-cluster TLS certs. We will throttle sync to keep P99 inference latency unaffected. Mirror nodes expose a read-only API token scope.

Imogen Shaw: HSM/FIPS note: mirrored artifacts are rewrapped with a customer-managed key on the mirror side. For air-gapped HSMs we provide a signed export package and an assisted import flow.

Priya Rao: Installer flags/examples:

```
redwoodctl onprem install --cluster ID --enable-mirror --mirror-mode read-replica --mirror-region eu-west-1
# to enable mirror post-install:
redwoodctl onprem mirror enable --cluster ID --region eu-west-1
```

Felipe Alvarez: Preflight command to validate network and cert setup:

```
redwoodctl onprem check-mirror --cluster ID --mirror-endpoint https://mirror.example.local
# expected: cert_valid: true, bandwidth_ok: true, auth_scope: read_only
```

Imogen Shaw: Data residency controls: customers can choose which namespaces to mirror (e.g., embeddings-only, logs-only). Default policy: mirror only non-sensitive indexes unless customer enables broader sync. Add this to compliance matrix.

Jordan Lee: CS action items: advisory, support playbook for assisted mirror setup, cost estimate template. Ill coordinate with Pricing for region-storage SKUs.

Nora Kim: Security Bot: please record that replication channels must enforce mTLS and mutual auth before enabling.

Security Bot: Policy check: replication requires mTLS + cipher suite AEAD (TLS1.3). Audit event: mirror.enable and mirror.sync_status emitted to audit log.

Felipe Alvarez: Monitoring: new dashboard will show sync lag (seconds), last-consistency-check, mirror-health, and read-only QPS. Alerting: sync_lag > 600s for >5min -> page SRE.

Imogen Shaw: Privacy note: for EU customers, well add a data-processor addendum addendum + controller mapping in the docs. Legal will draft standard contract language for mirrored datasets.

Priya Rao: Performance expectations: read-replica queries should be within 5-20ms of local index lookups depending on hardware; initial indexing/sync may take longer. Document contains benchmarks. Docs: https://docs.internal.redwood/onprem/data-residency-mirrors-2026

Nora Kim: Canary schedule: canary-1 (EU analytics partner) 2026-06-20T01:00Z, canary-2 (APAC retail) 2026-06-22T02:00Z. Will post results here after each run.

Jordan Lee: Ill prepare the customer-facing FAQ: "What is mirrored?", "Does mirroring change my SLA?", "How to enable/disable", "Pricing". Need Security & Legal review.

Felipe Alvarez: Ops rollout note: mirrors are billed as storage + egress per region. For on-prem private deployments, we bill management & support SKUs for sync assistance.

Imogen Shaw: For HSM customers: manual key export package example command will be added to appendix. SRE-assisted import estimated 2-4 business days depending on airgap.

Security Bot: Compliance emit: mirror.create, mirror.pause, mirror.resume, mirror.delete will audit to the pii-audit channel and record actor, timestamp, and justification string if created by admin.

Nora Kim: TL;DR action list:
- Eng/Infra: implement mirror API & monitoring (Felipe)
- Docs: publish guide + privacy/legal appendix (Nora/Imogen)
- CS: advisory + FAQ + pricing copy (Jordan)
- Security: audit hooks & mTLS enforcement (Security Bot / Imogen)
- Ops: schedule canaries & dashboards (Felipe)

Jordan Lee: Draft advisory link: https://docs.internal.redwood/cs/advisories/onprem-mirrors-preview. Will tag Legal/Security for review.

Nora Kim: Enforcement note: nothing auto-enforced for existing installs. Default behavior for new installs in supported regions will be mirror-capable but disabled. GA date target: 2026-08-15.

Felipe Alvarez: Canary update: scheduled jobs created. Posting results after run.

Imogen Shaw: Adding appendix for controller/processor mapping tonight.

Nora Kim: Thanks team. Reopen if exec wants a launch comms or product blog. :earth_asia:
